description: Four channels that each hold the last voltage read at their input and go on sending it after the cable is pulled

inputs.text: The voltage to pass on and store; storing starts once it has moved away from 0V, and an input held at a steady 0V leaves the stored voltage in place

outputs.text: Carries the voltage at its input, or the last stored voltage while nothing is patched in, including one saved with the patch

notes: the text field below each pair of jacks is a label for that channel and is saved with the patch.
